bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and bags larger than 14 × 15 inches are prohibited. Smaller bags must fit under the seat or on a lap and are searched on arrival.
allowed: Small bag that fits under seat or on lap
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Accessible spaces are available in the Hawthorne Municipal Ramp behind the Orpheum; its third-level skyway reaches the theater balcony. Other nearby downtown ramps may also be open.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Orpheum operator FAQ gives accessible drop-off areas but does not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Wine, beer, soft drinks and light snacks are sold inside. Outside food and drinks are prohibited except items needed for a disability or medical reason.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating accommodates the guest plus up to three ticketed companions. Request sign language interpretation at least two weeks ahead; listening devices are free from ushers with photo ID held until return.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Orpheum operator FAQ does not state a general concert re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: On show days, the Orpheum box office opens two hours before showtime. In the final hour before the show, it may serve only ticket needs for that performance.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Plan to arrive at least 30 minutes early for bag search and walk-through metal detector screening. The Orpheum show-day box office opens two hours before showtime; each concert sets its door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
